$comment: Names a tender's organisation chain uses for a district the ledger names differently. Only entries with status 'approved' are used; a proposed alias places nothing. Each alias applies within its state only, to one district. Checked by services/ingestion/tests/district-aliases.test.ts. A name that could mean two districts (Imphal: East or West) is never an alias; it goes to manual review.

aliases.evidence: Punjab has one district containing the name: Sri Muktsar Sahib. A Water Supply and Sanitation tender whose chain reads 'Division No. 2, Muktsar' gives its location as 'Sri Muktsar Sahib' (local collection, 2026-09).
Uttarakhand has one district containing the name: Pauri Garhwal. Chains read '12th Circle Pauri' and 'SPO Pauri'.
Uttarakhand has one district containing the name: Tehri Garhwal. Tenders give 'Tehri' as a location; no chain seen yet names it, so this alias places nothing until one does.
